name: image-generation
category: Multimodal · Capability gate (tool discovery + probe) → text-to-image via host capability → zero secrets
description: Generates images from text descriptions with zero secrets: no API key, no .env, no base URL — every image is produced through the host environment's built-in image generation capability. Before the skill becomes active in a session it runs a mandatory capability gate: discover an image generation tool among the session's tools, then run one minimal probe generation and verify a real image comes back. Both steps must pass, or the skill refuses to operate and reports honestly instead of falling back to placeholders or key-based workarounds.
